title.en: Intensive reading: Effects of Islamic culture
title.ur: Gehri qiraat: Islami saqafat ke asaar

intro.en: This reading shows how Muslims enriched human thought and science: tafsir, fiqh, astronomy, mathematics, optics, medicine and geography. Read it slowly, then do the comprehension drills.
intro.ur: Is qiraat mein hum dekhenge ke Musalmanon ne insani fikr aur uloom ko kaise aage barhaya: tafseer, fiqh, falak, riyaziyat, optics, tibb aur jughrafiya. Aahista parhein, phir sawalat hal karein.
intro.ar: يُبَيِّنُ هذا النَّصُّ كَيْفَ أَغْنى المُسْلِمونَ الفِكْرَ وَالعِلْمَ الإِنْسانِيَّ: في التَّفْسيرِ وَالفِقْهِ وَالفَلَكِ وَالرِّياضِيّاتِ وَالبَصَرِيّاتِ وَالطِّبِّ وَالجُغْرافْيا. اقْرَأْهُ بِبُطْءٍ ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةِ الفَهْمِ.

dialogue.ar: لِلثَّقافَةِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ أَثَرٌ كَبيرٌ في تاريخِ الفِكْرِ الإِنْسانِيِّ، فَقَدْ أَضافَتْ جَديداً إِلى كَثيرٍ مِنْ جَوانِبِ المَعْرِفَةِ.
dialogue.tr: lilththaqāfati l-ʾislāmiyyati atharun kabīrun fī tārīkhi l-fikri l-ʾinsāniyyi, faqad aḍāfat jadīdan ilā kathīrin min jawānibi l-maʿrifati.
dialogue.en: Islamic culture has a great effect on the history of human thought, for it added something new to many areas of knowledge.
dialogue.ur: Islami saqafat ka insani fikr ki tareekh par bara asar hai, kyunke us ne ilm ke kai pehluon mein kuch naya shamil kiya.

dialogue.ar: وَقامَتْ هَذِهِ الثَّقافَةُ عَلى الكِتابِ وَالسُّنَّةِ، فَكانَتْ مَصْدَرَ إِلْهامٍ لِلْعُلَماءِ في البَحْثِ وَالتَّعَلُّمِ.
dialogue.tr: waqāmat hādhihi th-thaqāfatu ʿalā l-kitābi wa-s-sunnati, fa-kānat maṣdara ilhāmin lilʿulamāʾi fī l-baḥthi wa-t-taʿallum.
dialogue.en: This culture stood on the Book and the Sunnah, so it was a source of inspiration for scholars in research and learning.
dialogue.ur: Yeh saqafat Kitab aur Sunnat par qaim thi, is liye ulama ke liye tahqeeq aur seekhne mein ilham ka sarchashma thi.

dialogue.ar: وَرَعى الخُلَفاءُ وَالأُمَراءُ وَالسَّلاطينُ العُلَماءَ، وَبَنَوُا المَكْتَباتِ وَالمَدارِسَ، وَشَجَّعوا التَّرْجَمَةَ وَالتَّأْليفَ.
dialogue.tr: waraʿā l-khulafāʾu wa-l-ʾumarāʾu wa-s-salāṭīnu l-ʿulamāʾ, wabanawuā l-maktabāti wa-l-madāris, washajjaʿū t-tarjamata wa-t-taʾlīf.
dialogue.en: Caliphs, emirs and sultans supported scholars, built libraries and schools, and encouraged translation and writing.
dialogue.ur: Khulafa, umara aur salateen ne ulama ki sarparasti ki, kutub khane aur madrase banaye aur tarjume aur tasneef ki hausla afzai ki.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ حاجَةِ المُسْلِمينَ إِلى فَهْمِ القُرْآنِ وَحَياةِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وُلِدَتْ عُلومُ التَّفْسيرِ وَالسِّيرَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wamin ḥājati l-muslimīna ilā fahmi l-qurʾāni waḥaiyāti n-nabiyyi ﷺ wulidat ʿulūmu t-tafsīri wa-s-sīrati.
dialogue.en: From the Muslims' need to understand the Quran and the life of the Prophet ﷺ were born the sciences of tafsir and seerah.
dialogue.ur: Quran aur Nabi ﷺ ki zindagi ko samajhne ki zaroorat se tafseer aur seerat ke ulum paida hue.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ حاجَتِهِمْ إِلى تَنْظيمِ شُؤونِ الحَياةِ نَشَأَ الفِقْهُ وَأُصولُهُ وَعِلْمُ التَّشْريعِ.
dialogue.tr: wamin ḥājatihim ilā tanẓīmi shuʾūni l-ḥaiyāti nashaʾa l-fiqhu waʾuṣūluhu waʿilmu t-tashrīʿ.
dialogue.en: From their need to organise the affairs of life arose fiqh, its principles and the science of legislation.
dialogue.ur: Zindagi ke mamlaat ko tarteeb dene ki zaroorat se fiqh, us ke usool aur ilm-e-tashree ubhra.

dialogue.ar: وَدَرَسَ العُلَماءُ الفَلَكَ وَالرِّياضِيّاتِ، فَكَتَبَ الخَوارِزْمِيُّ في الجَبْرِ، وَنَقَلَ المُسْلِمونَ الصِّفْرَ وَالأَرْقامَ إِلى العالَمِ.
dialogue.tr: wadarasa l-ʿulamāʾu l-falaka wa-r-riyāḍiyyāt, fakataba l-khawārizmiyyu fī l-jabr, wanaqala l-muslimūna ṣ-ṣifra wa-l-ʾarqāma ilā l-ʿālam.
dialogue.en: Scholars studied astronomy and mathematics; al-Khwarizmi wrote on algebra, and Muslims carried zero and the numerals to the world.
dialogue.ur: Ulama ne falakiyat aur riyaziyat parhi; Khwarizmi ne algebra par likha aur musalmanon ne sifr aur ginti ke nishan duniya tak pohanchaye.

dialogue.ar: وَاعْتَمَدَ ابْنُ الهَيْثَمِ المَنْهَجَ التَّجْريبِيَّ في دِراسَةِ الضَّوْءِ، وَكانَ كِتابُهُ «المَناظِرُ» مِنْ أَهَمِّ مُنْجَزاتِهِ في الفيزياءِ.
dialogue.tr: wāʿtamada bnu l-haythami l-manhaja t-tajrībiyya fī dirāsati ḍ-ḍawʾ, wakāna kitābuhu l-manāẓiru min ahammi munjazātihi fī l-fīziyāʾ.
dialogue.en: Ibn al-Haytham relied on the experimental method in studying light, and his book «al-Manazir» was among his most important achievements in physics.
dialogue.ur: Ibn al-Haitham ne roshni ke mutale mein tajrubati tareeqa apnaya aur un ki kitab «al-Manazir» physics mein un ki aham tareen kamyabiyon mein se hai.

dialogue.ar: وَاشْتُهِرَ جابِرُ بْنُ حَيّانَ في الكيمياءِ، وَابْنُ سينا في الطِّبِّ، وَظَلَّ كِتابُهُ «القانونُ» مَرْجِعاً لِلْأَطِبّاءِ قُروناً طَويلَةً.
dialogue.tr: wāshtuhira jābiru bnu ḥayyāna fī l-kīmiyāʾ, wābnu sīnā fī ṭ-ṭibbi, waẓalla kitābuhu l-qānūnu marjiʿan lilʾaṭibbāʾi qurūnan ṭaūīlatan.
dialogue.en: Jabir ibn Hayyan became famous in chemistry and Ibn Sina in medicine, and his book «al-Qanun» remained a reference for doctors for long centuries.
dialogue.ur: Jabir bin Hayyan kimiya mein aur Ibn Sina tibb mein mashhoor hue, aur un ki kitab «al-Qanun» sadiyon tak doctoron ka hawala rahi.

dialogue.ar: وَرَسَمَ الإِدْريسِيُّ خَريطَةً لِلْعالَمِ، وَأَسْهَمَ الجُغْرافِيّونَ في تَصْويرِ الكُرَةِ الأَرْضِيَّةِ، وَما هَذا إِلّا مَثَلٌ عَلى اخْتِراعٍ وَكَشْفٍ كَثيرٍ.
dialogue.tr: warasama l-ʾidrīsiyyu kharīṭatan lilʿālam, waʾashama l-jughrāfiyyūna fī taṣūīri l-kurati l-ʾarḍiyyati, wamā hādhā illā mathalun ʿalā khtirāʿin wakashfin kathīrin.
dialogue.en: Al-Idrisi drew a map of the world and geographers helped picture the globe of the earth; this is only one example of much invention and discovery.
dialogue.ur: Idrisi ne duniya ka naqsha banaya aur jughrafiya-danon ne kura-e-arz ki tasweer kashi mein hissa liya; yeh sirf ek misal hai, ijaadat aur daryaft bohat hain.

dialogue.ar: وَهَكَذا كانَتْ هَذِهِ الثَّقافَةُ جِسْراً بَيْنَ حَضاراتِ الماضِي وَنَهْضَةِ العالَمِ الحَديثِ.
dialogue.tr: wahakadhā kānat hādhihi th-thaqāfatu jisran bayna ḥaḍārāti l-māḍī wanahḍati l-ʿālami l-ḥadīth.
dialogue.en: In this way, this culture was a bridge between the civilisations of the past and the rise of the modern world.
dialogue.ur: Yun yeh saqafat maazi ki tehzeebon aur jadeed duniya ki nashat-e-saniya ke darmiyan ek pul thi.

q.ur: Ibn al-Haytham kis ilm mein mashhoor hai?

q.ur: Kiski kitab al-Qanun Europe ki jamiaat mein parhai gayi?
q.ar: صاحِبُ كِتابِ «القانونِ» الَّذي دُرِّسَ في الجامِعاتِ الأُورُبِّيَّةِ هُوَ:

intro.en: Arabic has many kinds of plural. Sound masculine plural adds ـونَ/ـينَ (مُسْلِمونَ). Sound feminine plural adds ـات (مُسْلِماتٌ). A broken plural changes the shape of the word (كِتاب → كُتُب). Also learn collective nouns like عَرَب and أَسَد.
intro.ur: Arabi mein jam' ki kai qismen hain. Jam' muzakkar salim mein ـونَ/ـينَ lagta hai (مُسْلِمونَ). Jam' muannas salim mein ـات (مُسْلِماتٌ). Jam' taksir mein lafz ki shakal badal jati hai (كِتاب → كُتُب). Ism-e-jins aur ism-e-jam' bhi seekhein.
intro.ar: لِلْجَمْعِ في العَرَبِيَّةِ أَنْواعٌ كَثيرَةٌ. جَمْعُ المُذَكَّرِ السّالِمُ يَزيدُ ـونَ أَوْ ـينَ (مُسْلِمونَ)، وَجَمْعُ المُؤَنَّثِ السّالِمُ يَزيدُ ـات (مُسْلِماتٌ)، وَجَمْعُ التَّكْسيرِ يَتَغَيَّرُ فيهِ شَكْلُ الكَلِمَةِ (كِتابٌ ← كُتُبٌ). وَتَتَعَلَّمُ أَيْضاً اسْمَ الجَمْعِ وَاسْمَ الجِنْسِ مِثْلَ عَرَب وَأَسَد.

q.en: Which is a sound masculine plural?
q.ur: Inmein se jam' muzakkar salim kaun sa hai?

q.en: Which is a sound feminine plural?
q.ur: Jam' muannas salim kaun sa hai?
Jam' taksir mein kya hota hai?

intro.en: Two listening texts about Muslim minorities: first in Europe and North America, then in South America and Australia. After listening, answer true/false statements about what you heard.
intro.ur: Do sunne ke matn hain: pehla Europe aur Shimali Amrika ki Muslim aqliyyaton ke baare mein, doosra Junubi Amrika aur Australia ke baare mein. Sunne ke baad sahih/ghalat jawab dein.
intro.ar: نَصّانِ لِلِاسْتِماعِ عَنِ الأَقَلِّيّاتِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ: الأَوَّلُ في أُورُبّا وَأَمْريكا الشَّمالِيَّةِ، وَالثّاني في أَمْريكا الجَنوبِيَّةِ وَأُسْتْرالْيا. بَعْدَ الِاسْتِماعِ تَحْكُمُ عَلى جُمَلٍ بِصَحيحٍ أَوْ خَطَأٍ.

q.ar: في أَيِّ هذِهِ الأَسْماءِ تَعيشُ حَيَواناتُ الكَنْغَرِ؟

intro.en: In this lesson you choose a topic, prepare a speech and deliver it to your classmates without reading. Plan the main points, evidence and examples first.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein aap koi mauzu chunte hain, taqreer taiyar karte hain aur sathiyon ke samne bina parhe sunate hain. Pehle ahem nukte, dalail aur misalein likh len.
intro.ar: في هذا الدَّرْسِ تَخْتارُ مَوْضوعاً وَتُحَضِّرُ خُطْبَةً وَتُلْقيها أَمامَ زُمَلائِكَ دونَ قِراءَةٍ. خَطِّطْ أَوَّلاً لِلْعَناصِرِ الرَّئيسَةِ وَالأَدِلَّةِ وَالأَمْثِلَةِ.

q.en: What do you do in this exercise?
q.ur: Is mashq mein aap kya karte hain?

options: Choose a topic and give a speech
Fill in blanks with derived words

intro.en: Derived nouns are formed from verbs. Example: from جَلَسَ we get جالِس (doer), from ضَرَبَ we get مَضْروب (receiver of the action), and مَكْتَب (place). Learn the eight kinds and what each one means.
intro.ur: Mushtaqqat woh alfaz hain jo fel se bante hain. Misal: جَلَسَ se جالِس (karne wala), ضَرَبَ se مَضْروب (jis par kaam hua), aur مَكْتَب (jagah). Aathon qismein aur unke maani seekhein.
intro.ar: المُشْتَقّاتُ أَسْماءٌ تُؤْخَذُ مِنَ الأَفْعالِ. مِثالُ ذلِكَ: مِنْ جَلَسَ نَأْخُذُ جالِس (الفاعِلُ)، وَمِنْ ضَرَبَ نَأْخُذُ مَضْروب (الَّذي وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ الفِعْلُ)، وَمَكْتَب (المَكانُ). تَعَلَّمِ الأَنْواعَ الثَّمانِيَةَ وَمَعْنى كُلٍّ مِنْها.

options_ar: صيغَةِ مُبالَغَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى كَثْرَةِ الصَّبْرِ

title.en: Extended reading: A letter from France (a life story)
title.ur: Wasee qiraat: France se ek khat (aik zindagi ki kahani)

intro.en: A moving story about a poor vegetable seller and his wife who sacrifice everything so their only daughter can study medicine in France. Read it, then answer the questions.
intro.ur: Ek gareeb sabzi farosh aur us ki biwi ki dil ko chhune wali kahani, jo apni waahid beti ko France mein tibb parhane ke liye sab kuch qurban kar dete hain. Parhein, phir sawalat ke jawab dein.
intro.ar: قِصَّةٌ مُؤَثِّرَةٌ عَنْ بائِعِ خُضْراواتٍ فَقيرٍ وَزَوْجَتِهِ يُضَحِّيانِ بِكُلِّ ما يَمْلِكانِ لِتَدْرُسَ ابْنَتُهُما الوَحيدَةُ الطِّبَّ في فَرَنْسا. اقْرَأْها ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ.

dialogue.ar: كُنْتُ رَجُلاً مَسْتوراً أَفْتَحُ دُكّاني في الصَّباحِ الباكِرِ، وَأَبيعُ الخُضْراواتِ لِأَهْلِ حَيِّنا.
dialogue.tr: kuntu rajulan mastūran aftaḥu dukkānī fī ṣ-ṣabāḥi l-bākir, waʾabīʿu l-khuḍrāwāti liʾahli ḥayyinā.
dialogue.en: I was a man of modest means; I opened my shop early in the morning and sold vegetables to the people of our neighbourhood.
dialogue.ur: Main ek saada hal aadmi tha, subah sawere apni dukaan kholta aur apne mohalle walon ko sabziyan bechta.

dialogue.ar: وَكُنّا أَنا وَزَوْجَتي نَأْكُلُ طَعاماً مُتَواضِعاً، وَلَكِنَّنا نَنامُ حامِدينَ اللهَ عَلى ما أَنْعَمَ بِهِ عَلَيْنا مِنْ نِعَمٍ.
dialogue.tr: wakunnā anā wazawjatī naʾkulu ṭaʿāman mutawāḍiʿan, walakinnanā nanāmu ḥāmidīna Allāh ʿalā mā anʿama bihi ʿalaynā min niʿamin.
dialogue.en: My wife and I ate simple food, but we slept thanking Allah for the blessings He had given us.
dialogue.ur: Main aur meri biwi saada khana khate, magar Allah ki di hui nematon par us ka shukr ada karte hue sote.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ سَنَواتٍ مِنَ الانْتِظارِ حَمَلَتْ زَوْجَتي، فَدَخَلَتِ الفَرْحَةُ بَيْتَنا وَلَمْ تَخْرُجْ مِنْهُ.
dialogue.tr: wabaʿda sanawātin mina l-āntiẓāri ḥamalat zawjatī, fadakhalati l-farḥatu baytanā walam takhruj minh.
dialogue.en: After years of waiting my wife became pregnant, and joy entered our home and did not leave it.
dialogue.ur: Kai saal intezar ke baad meri biwi hamla se hui to khushi hamare ghar mein aayi aur phir nikli nahin.

dialogue.ar: وَجاءَتِ القابِلَةُ بَعْدَ ساعاتٍ تَقولُ: البِشارَةُ يا أَبا هِنْدٍ، رُزِقْتَ بِنْتاً كَالقَمَرِ!
dialogue.tr: wajāʾati l-qābilatu baʿda sāʿātin taqūl: al-bishāratu yā abā hindin, ruziqta bintan ka-l-qamar!
dialogue.en: After some hours the midwife came and said: Good news, Abu Hind, you have been given a daughter like the moon!
dialogue.ur: Chand ghanton baad dai aayi aur boli: Mubarak ho Abu Hind, aap ko chand si beti ata hui hai!

dialogue.ar: فَلَمّا بَلَغَتْ هِنْدٌ سِنَّ المَدْرَسَةِ قالَتْ أُمُّها: لَنْ تَكونَ بائِعَةَ خُضْراواتٍ، سَتَكونُ طَبيبَةً.
dialogue.tr: falammā balaghat hindun sinna l-madrasati qālat ummuhā: lan takūna bāʾiʿata khuḍrāwātin, satakūnu ṭabībatan.
dialogue.en: When Hind reached school age her mother said: She will not be a vegetable seller, she will be a doctor.
dialogue.ur: Jab Hind school ki umar ko pohanchi to us ki ammi ne kaha: Yeh sabzi bechne wali nahin banegi, doctor banegi.

dialogue.ar: وَأَصَرَّتِ الأُمُّ عَلى رَأْيِها، فَسَجَّلْنا هِنْداً في المَدْرَسَةِ، وَحَصَلَتْ عَلى الشَّهادَةِ الابْتِدائِيَّةِ ثُمَّ الثّانَوِيَّةِ بِتَفَوُّقٍ.
dialogue.tr: waʾaṣarrati l-ʾummu ʿalā raʾyihā, fasajjalnā hindan fī l-madrasati, waḥaṣalat ʿalā sh-shahādati l-ābtidāʾiyyati thumma th-thānawiyyati bitafawwuqin.
dialogue.en: She insisted on it, so we put Hind in school, and she earned the primary certificate and then the secondary one with distinction.
dialogue.ur: Us ne is par israr kiya, chunancha humne Hind ko school dakhil karaya aur us ne primary phir secondary ka sanad imtiyaz ke saath hasil kiya.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ قُبِلَتْ في الجامِعَةِ، وَأَرادَتْ أَنْ تُسافِرَ إِلى فَرَنْسا لِتُكْمِلَ دِراسَةَ الطِّبِّ هُناكَ.
dialogue.tr: thumma qubilat fī l-jāmiʿati, waʾarādat an tusāfira ilā faransā litukmila dirāsata ṭ-ṭibbi hunāk.
dialogue.en: Then she was accepted into university, and she wanted to travel to France to complete her medical studies there.
dialogue.ur: Phir use university mein dakhila mila aur us ne chaha ke France ja kar wahan tibb ki parhai mukammal kare.

dialogue.ar: فَاسْتَدَنْتُ مِنَ التُّجّارِ، وَباعَتْ زَوْجَتي ذَهَبَها، وَسافَرَتْ هِنْدٌ وَهِيَ تَعِدُنا بِرِسالَةٍ كُلَّ أُسْبوعٍ.
dialogue.tr: fāstadantu mina t-tujjār, wabāʿat zawjatī dhahabahā, wasāfarat hindun wahiya taʿidunā birisālatin kulla usbūʿin.
dialogue.en: So I borrowed from the merchants, my wife sold her gold, and Hind travelled promising us a letter every week.
dialogue.ur: Maine tajiron se qarz liya, meri biwi ne apna sona becha aur Hind hum se har hafte ek khat ka wada karke safar par chali gayi.

dialogue.ar: وَمَرَّتْ شُهورٌ ثَقيلَةٌ، وَتَراكَمَتِ الدُّيونُ، فَلَمْ يَبْقَ في بَيْتِنا شَيْءٌ يُباعُ إِلّا الغَسّالَةُ، فَبِعْتُها أَيْضاً.
dialogue.tr: wamarrat shuhūrun thaqīlatun, watarākamati d-dīūn, falam yabqa fī baytinā shayʾun yubāʿu illā l-ghassālatu, fabiʿtuhā ayḍan.
dialogue.en: Heavy months passed and the debts piled up, until nothing was left in our house to sell except the washing machine, and I sold that too.
dialogue.ur: Bhaari mahine guzre, qarz barhta gaya, yahan tak ke ghar mein bechne ko sirf kapde dhone ki machine bachi, wo bhi maine bech di.

dialogue.ar: وَجاءَني يَوْماً رَجُلٌ مِنَ المَحْكَمَةِ يَقولُ: إِمّا أَنْ تَدْفَعَ الدَّيْنَ وَإِمّا أَنْ تَدْخُلَ الحَبْسَ.
dialogue.tr: wajāʾanī yawman rajulun mina l-maḥkamati yaqūl: immā an tadfaʿa d-dayna waʾimmā an tadkhula l-ḥabs.
dialogue.en: One day a man from the court came to me and said: Either you pay the debt or you enter prison.
dialogue.ur: Ek din adalat se ek aadmi aaya aur bola: Ya to qarz ada karo ya qaid mein jao.

dialogue.ar: وَشَعَرْتُ بِالذُّلِّ لِأَوَّلِ مَرَّةٍ في حَياتي، وَقُلْتُ في نَفْسي: هَذا إِفْلاسٌ كامِلٌ، وَلَكِنَّ هِنْداً لا يَجِبُ أَنْ تَعْرِفَ.
dialogue.tr: washaʿartu bi-dh-dhulli liʾawwali marratin fī ḥaiyātī, waqultu fī nafsī: hādhā iflāsun kāmilun, walakinna hindan lā yajibu an taʿrif.
dialogue.en: I felt humiliation for the first time in my life and said to myself: This is complete bankruptcy, but Hind must not know.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe zindagi mein pehli baar zillat mehsoos hui aur maine apne aap se kaha: Yeh poora diwaliya pan hai, magar Hind ko pata nahin chalna chahiye.

dialogue.ar: فَأَرْسَلْتُ إِلَيْها بَرْقِيَّةً قَصيرَةً: «أَبوكِ بِخَيْرٍ، اِجْتَهِدي»، وَلَمْ أَذْكُرْ لَها شَيْئاً عَنِ الدُّيونِ.
dialogue.tr: faʾarsaltu ilayhā barqiyyatan qaṣīratan: abūki bikhayrin, ijtahidī, walam adhkur lahā shayʾan ʿani d-dīūn.
dialogue.en: So I sent her a short telegram: "Your father is well, work hard," and I told her nothing about the debts.
dialogue.ur: Chunancha maine use ek mukhtasar taar bheja: «Tumhare abbu theek hain, mehnat karo», aur qarz ke bare mein kuch nahin likha.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ سَنَواتٍ وَصَلَتْنا رِسالَةٌ مِنْها: «تَخَرَّجْتُ يا أَبي، وَسَأَعودُ الأُسْبوعَ القادِمَ».
dialogue.tr: wabaʿda sanawātin waṣalatnā risālatun minhā: takharrajtu yā abī, wasaʾaʿūdu l-ʾusbūʿa l-qādim.
dialogue.en: After some years a letter reached us from her: "I have graduated, Father, and I will return next week."
dialogue.ur: Kuch saal baad hamein us ka khat mila: «Abbu, main fariq-ut-tahsil ho gayi, aur agle hafte wapas aaungi».

dialogue.ar: وَعادَتْ هِنْدٌ طَبيبَةً، فَوَقَفَتْ في دُكّاني وَقَبَّلَتْ يَدَيَّ وَقالَتْ: يا أَبي، ظَنَّ النّاسُ أَنَّكُما مَجْنونانِ، وَأَنا أَعْرِفُ أَنَّكُما أَحْكَمُ الآباءِ.
dialogue.tr: waʿādat hindun ṭabībatan, fawaqafat fī dukkānī waqabbalat yadayya wa qālat: yā abī, ẓanna n-nāsu annakumā majnūnān, waʾanā aʿrifu annakumā aḥkamu l-ʾābāʾ.
dialogue.en: Hind came back a doctor, stood in my shop, kissed my hands and said: Father, people thought you both were mad, and I know you are the wisest of parents.
dialogue.ur: Hind doctor ban kar lauti, meri dukaan par khadi hui, mere haath chume aur boli: Abbu, logon ne socha ke aap dono deewane hain, aur main jaanti hoon ke aap sab se daana walidain hain.

dialogue.ar: وَسَدَّدَتْ دُيونَنا كُلَّها وَقالَتْ: هَذا قَليلٌ مِنْ فَضْلِكُما عَلَيَّ.
dialogue.tr: wasaddadat dīūnanā kullahā wa qālat: hādhā qalīlun min faḍlikumā ʿalayya.
dialogue.en: She paid off all our debts and said: This is a little of your kindness to me.
dialogue.ur: Us ne hamare saare qarz chuka diye aur kaha: Yeh mujh par aap dono ke ehsan ka thoda sa badla hai.

vocab.en: a modest man of limited means

q.en: What did the mother want her daughter to become?
q.ur: Ammi apni beti ko kya banana chahti thi?
q.ar: ماذا أَرادَتِ الأُمُّ أَنْ تَصيرَ ابْنَتُها؟

q.en: Where did Hind travel to study?
q.ur: Hind parhne ke liye kahan gayi?

q.en: Why did the father sell the washing machine?
q.ur: Walid ne kapde dhone ki machine kyun bechi?

options: To pay the debts caused by his daughter's studies
To move to a bigger house
options_ar: لِيُسَدِّدَ الدُّيونَ الَّتي تَراكَمَتْ بِسَبَبِ دِراسَةِ ابْنَتِهِ
